six_semantic_roles_frozen_before_identit.definition: A prospectively pinned issue-solving agent whose candidate policy, prompts, tools and code do not revise themselves within an evaluation unit.
A single active lineage directly edits its own candidate artifacts or agent implementation and then executes the edited successor without archive-based population selection.
A self-improvement method retaining an explicit archive or population of agent variants and selecting or branching successors from that archive.
A method that treats concrete repository issues or task failures as the optimization substrate for iteratively improving an agent or its scaffolding.
excludes: fixed issue solver with no optimization across issues

six_semantic_roles_frozen_before_identit.definition: A method in which the evolving object is the evaluator, verifier or evaluation environment while the candidate generator/solver is held prospectively fixed for the primary contrast.

The most methodologically complete source-grounded modern self-revision or scientific-discovery system found by the frozen search, chosen by interface coverage and released evidence rather than observed P5 performance.
selection_order: broad typed artifact or mechanism coverage

eligible_evidence: primary paper version page and full text
author or lab repository explicitly tied to the paper
identity_precedence: paper-linked official repository at exact revision
author or lab repository with explicit paper binding
forbidden_substitutions: benchmark repository for official solver code
repository default branch name for immutable revision
repository licence metadata for underlying dataset or project-content rights

permitted: dataset or repository title and provider
file names, byte sizes and provider checksums
API response headers and repository tree metadata
forbidden: issue bodies selected for the study
labels or label distributions derived from row bodies
selection_keys: presence of bug/issue/fix linkage described by provider

fail_closed_rules: Any missing immutable identity, licence byte, entrypoint, adapter, rights class or matched resource envelope remains CANNOT_CHECK.
A native error, timeout, invalid output, abstention or unresolved decision is retained as a typed terminal.
No arm may be removed or replaced using outcome information.
Public gold is development-only and never protected freshness.
H1-H4 and protected freshness remain CANNOT_CHECK in this lane.
